The provided text aligns strongly with the conventions of the hardboiled detective and noir genres. By setting the narrative during Prohibition, it utilizes a historical backdrop that is frequently associated with moral ambiguity and systemic corruption, key thematic pillars of noir. The protagonist, a renowned detective investigating organized crime, fits the archetypal role of the cynical or weary investigator common in the genre. Furthermore, the explicit mention of themes such as morality, corruption, and the pursuit of justice confirms that the story adheres to the genre-specific focus on ethical dilemmas and the flawed nature of justice.
